subject: world_language
concept: Understanding cultural nuance and context-dependent meaning in target-language media (short clips, articles, songs)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a cultural reference in target-language media to its real-world cultural context
exercise.abstract: Student explains a piece of cultural context needed to fully understand a described target-language media excerpt

misconception_flags: interprets a culturally specific reference using only their own cultural assumptions

interest_binding: media content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
